requested_changes.body: Can we change this to check `sys.version_info` like the change in `mathimpl` please? When 3.10 support is eventually dropped, it's easier to spot old dead implementations if they reference the lower version bound than just using `hasattr`.
requested_changes.diff_hunk:
@@ -40,7 +40,8 @@ class Math_unary(ConcreteTemplate):
         signature(types.float32, types.float32),
         signature(types.float64, types.float64),
     ]
-
+if hasattr(math, 'exp2'):

requested_changes.body:
I think this will need a guard to ensure it doesn't break Python < 3.11.

(However, the CUDA changes should be taken out of this PR, and added to a PR in https://github.com/NVIDIA/numba-cuda) instead please.
